import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import pandas as pd

# Load the data
coffee_sales = pd.read_csv('data/coffee_sales.csv')

# Convert date column to datetime
coffee_sales['date'] = pd.to_datetime(coffee_sales['date'])

# Create a bar chart to show the most popular products
popular_products = coffee_sales['product'].value_counts().head(10)
plt.figure(figsize=(10,6))
sns.barplot(x=popular_products.index, y=popular_products.values, palette='Blues_d')
plt.title('Top 10 Most Popular Products')
plt.xlabel('Product')
plt.ylabel('Frequency')
plt.xticks(rotation=90)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
